newsitem.title: USA: APICS U.S. March business outlook index up to 51.1.
newsitem.headline: APICS U.S. March business outlook index up to 51.1.

text.p: The American Production and Inventory Control Society (APICS) business outlook index rose to 51.1 in March from 47.8 in February.
The current component index advanced to 50.4 from 48.8 during the same period, with the future component index up to 51.9 from 46.9.
A reading of 50 indicates neutral sentiment, APICS said.
"The pickup in March activity is probably tied to the strong showing of consumer spending at the beginning of the year and weather-aided rebound in construction," APICS said.
The APICS index is compiled monthly from a survey of manufacturing firms and is calculated by averaging respondents' ratings of current and future conditions.
Of the five current components, inventories and unfilled orders had the biggest monthly gains, at 46.1 and 56.3, respectively.
All three future components increased in March.
